Title: Add admin UI for creating, editing and managing activities and participants

Description:
Provide an admin interface (simple React or server-rendered pages) that allows school staff to create activities, edit details, manage schedules and view/remove participants.

Acceptance criteria:
- Admin UI page to list activities with edit/delete actions.
- Forms to create and edit activity details (description, schedule, max participants).
- UI to view and remove participants for an activity.
- Admin pages protected by authentication.

Suggested tasks:
- Add `frontend/admin` or `static/admin.html` with forms and pages.
- Integrate admin UI with API endpoints.
- Add basic styling and validation.

Priority: Medium
Estimate: 2 days
